$comment: Admin-owned. Lists every team and the GitHub logins allowed to publish to teams/<slug>/. Logins are case-insensitive. While a team's list is empty, any GitHub user may open a pull request to its folder; admins review every PR before it goes live. Fill the list to lock a team down. "icon" is a symbol id from shared/assets/icons.svg, shown on the directory card.
